info.name: QAssure — Notification System API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for QAssure Notification System.

## Setup
1. Set `base_url` variable to your server (e.g. http://localhost:3000)
2. Run folder '01 — Authentication' first to get tokens
3. All other requests use saved tokens automatically

## What is covered
- All 8 REST notification endpoints
- WebSocket connection instructions
- Preference management
- Admin endpoints (templates, alert rules, escalation rules)
- Security tests (401, 403 verification)

## Verified against live QAssure server — April 2026

item.name: 02 — User Notifications

exec: console.log('No notifications found for this user');

request.description:
Returns current user's notifications. Ordered newest first. Excludes dismissed and expired.

Response data array contains notification objects with:
- id, title, message, notification_type, category, priority
- entity_type, entity_id, entity_name, action_url
- is_read, read_at, is_dismissed, dismissed_at
- created_at, expires_at

item.name: Get My Notifications — Filter Unread Only

request.description: Returns only unread notifications. All returned items should have is_read: false.

request.description: Filter by category. Valid values: capa, document, training, workflow, supplier, system

request.description:
Marks a single notification as read. notification_id is auto-populated by Get My Notifications.

Alternative: send mark_read WebSocket event with { notificationId: 'uuid' }

Marks ALL unread notifications as read for the current user.

Response: { success: true, data: { marked_count: number } }

Dismisses ALL notifications for the current user.

Response: { success: true, data: { dismissed_count: number } }

item.name: 03 — Preferences

request.description: Update category preferences. Only send fields you want to update.
Enable quiet hours from 10pm to 7am IST. Urgent notifications bypass quiet hours.
Master switch to disable ALL in-app notifications. No in-app notifications will be delivered when this is false.
Reset all preferences back to defaults.

item.description: Get and update the current user's notification preferences.

item.name: 04 — Admin: Send Notifications

body.raw:
{
  "user_id": "{{regular_user_id}}",
  "title": "Test Notification",
  "message": "This is a test notification sent via admin API",
  "notification_type": "info",
  "category": "system",
  "priority": "normal",
  "entity_type": "test",
  "action_url": "/dashboard"
}

request.description:
Send a notification to a specific user by user_id.

notification_type values: info, success, warning, action_required
category values: capa, document, training, workflow, supplier, system
priority values: normal, high, urgent

body.raw:
{
  "user_ids": ["{{tenant_admin_user_id}}", "{{regular_user_id}}"],
  "title": "Broadcast Notification",
  "message": "This notification was sent to multiple users",
  "notification_type": "info",
  "category": "system",
  "priority": "normal"
}

request.description: Send the same notification to multiple users by user_ids array.

body.raw:
{
  "role": "quality_manager",
  "title": "Role Broadcast",
  "message": "All quality managers: please review the new supplier submission",
  "notification_type": "action_required",
  "category": "supplier",
  "priority": "high"
}

request.description: Send notification to all users with a specific role in the tenant. Uses role code (e.g. quality_manager, tenant_admin, viewer).
Send a notification using a pre-defined template code. Dynamic variables like {{entity_name}} in the template will be replaced by variables provided in the request body.

item.description: Admin endpoints for sending notifications manually. Requires notifications:write permission.
